title: centaurium davyi
intro: Centaurium davyi, commonly known as mountain bluets, is a flowering plant species within the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to support the health of the urinary tract and has been shown to have various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of Centaurium davyi include its diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include iridoids, such as gentiopicrin, which are found in the plant's roots and other parts.
